title: Tamil Literature Flowers — Full Stack Web App
readme_snippet:
# 🌸 Tamil Literature Flowers — Full Stack Web App

A comprehensive full-stack web application showcasing 99 Kuruchi flowers from Tamil Sangam literature, organized by the traditional 5 Tinai (landscapes) with AI-powered information retrieval, user authentication, gamification, a chatbot, and real-time SMS/Telegram notifications.

---

## 🌺 Features

- **🌿 99 Tamil Sangam Flowers** — Organized by 5 Tinai landscapes with AI descriptions
- **🔐 User Authentication** — Register, Login, Profile management with SQLite
- **🤖 AI Chatbot** — Groq-powered chatbot for Tamil flower queries
- **🎮 Gamification** — Points, achievements, and progress tracking
- **📲 Telegram Bot** — `@TamilFloraBot` for flower info via Telegram
- **📱 SMS Notifications** — Twilio SMS alerts for key events
- **⏰ Scheduler** — Auto background tasks for notifications
- **📊 Admin Dashboard** — Analytics, search stats, user feedback
- **🔍 Real-time Search** — Autocomplete flower search with AI results
- **📡 REST API** — Full API for flower data, analytics, and feedback

---
